# acecloud_key_pair (Resource)

Manages an Ace Cloud SSH key pair.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the key pair.

### Optional

- `public_key` (String) SSH public key. If not provided, the backend will generate a key pair.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint of the SSH public key.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the key pair.
